title: Comfort Club Term, Renewal and Reinstatement Schedule
content:
The Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements run term by term. This schedule sets, per tier, the term length, the renewal notice, the renewal grace period, the reinstatement fee, the price lock and loyalty terms on renewal, and whether an active agreement may move into the tier in the middle of a term.

| Tier | Term length (months) | Renewal notice (calendar days before term end) | Renewal grace (calendar days after term end) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Price lock on renewal | Loyalty discount on annual renewal dues | Consecutive terms needed for the loyalty discount (counting the renewing term) | Mid-term upgrade into this tier allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 12 | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | No | 0% | 3 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Silver | 12 | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | Yes | 5% | 3 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Gold | 12 | 30 | 45 | 25.00 | Yes | 5% | 3 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 12 | 30 | 45 | 0.00 | Yes | 5% | 3 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 12 | 30 | 60 | 0.00 | Yes | 10% | 3 | No |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 12 | 30 | 60 | 0.00 | Yes | 10% | 3 | No |

## Definitions

- **Renewal grace**: the calendar days after term end during which a lapsed agreement may be reinstated.
- **Reinstatement fee**: the fee charged when a lapsed agreement is reinstated; 0.00 means none.
- **Price lock on renewal**: whether the first-system annual rate the member last paid is locked for automatic renewals.
- **Loyalty discount**: a percentage off annual renewal dues once the loyalty term count is reached; the loyalty term count is the number of consecutive terms, counting the renewing term, needed for it.
- **Mid-term upgrade into the tier**: whether an active agreement may move into this tier in the middle of a term.

## Read-offs
- The grace period lengthens with the tier: 30, 30, 45, 45, 60 and 60 days from Comfort Club Basic to Comfort Club Total Home.
- Comfort Club Basic is the only tier without a price lock, and it carries a 0% loyalty discount.
- Comfort Club Platinum Plus and Comfort Club Total Home cannot be entered by a mid-term upgrade.
